items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: She was my singer, we went in the Paramount

ctx.x: You know, she told about how she would

Yeah, it was murder. Of course then when she left the band that was quite a story too. She was my singer, we went in the Paramount, and Dinah Shore was the headline act, and of course as the band singer in the Paramount you always played an opening number, and then your girl singer came on. Well, Lena came on and when she got through there was nothing left for Dinah. And Dinah got sick. She said, 'I'm going to be sick until that girl is removed from the bill.'
